evidence.itemized: EEXI = Σ_i [(P_i × SFOC_i × CF_i) / (f_i × f_c × f_l × Capacity × V_ref)]
evidence.observation: the two 'algorithms' share one and the same denominator (f_i x f_c x f_l x Capacity x V_ref); distributing Sigma over a constant denominator is an algebraic identity, so rel_diff in {0, 1.75e-16} is arithmetic, not independent physical validation.
